label: About
title: About One Eye Above the Waterline
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 11 recent saved-signal files and 5 captured links, then narrowed the page to 1 source windows around @gucci4mycat: Halloween special will be free for holders of my prev collections. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became One Eye Above the Waterline: Landscape wet-stain painting on wide flat turquoise. Left: three faint line-only anime face echoes stacked, one tear, melting into indigo hair drips. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 1 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against torn indigo stain island around the amber eye, amber slit-pupil iris with red-flecked scaly surround, and thin red horizontal line from tear-face to beast eye.

typography.rationale: Fraunces and Newsreader fit image-led art objects while Space Grotesk keeps process labels crisp.
